# webtables/call

> Function call: the arguments are pushed on the memory stack right to left.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/call.pkg) · translates [std/call](../std/call.md)

As in bintables, so side effects in arguments happen in the same order.
The callee pops them.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when args empty`

```nasm
(call ${callee.label})
```

### `emit`

```nasm
(block (result i64)
{each args reverse}
(call $__pk_push
{it}
)
{end}
(call ${callee.label}))
```
